title: Claude Skills Marketplace — Themed Skill Packs for Claude Code and Claude.ai
author: 90n
summary: A repository of free, themed agent skill packs for Claude Code and Claude.ai covering HR, leadership, recruiting, customer service, product and project management, training, and design. Packs bundle task-specific SKILL.md instructions with shared reference files and can be installed as Claude Code plugins or downloaded as individual skills for Claude.ai.
